description: This file defines the main administrative UI shell for a Flutter web application, including a sidebar, topbar, content pages, navigation, and authentication handling.

classes.name: AdminPanelShell
classes.description: Main widget for the admin panel UI, managing state, navigation, and authentication.

classes.name: _AdminSideBar
classes.description: Sidebar widget displaying navigation options and sign-out button.

classes.name: _NavItem
classes.description: Helper class representing a navigation item with icon, label, and builder.

classes.name: _BrandBadge
classes.description: Visual badge representing the brand/logo in the topbar.

classes.name: _TopSearchField
classes.description: Search input field displayed in the topbar.

classes.name: _UserChip
classes.description: Displays the current user's email and avatar in the topbar.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, sets up routes, and checks user session.

methods.name: _checkSession
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the user is authenticated by reading stored tokens.

methods.name: _signout
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget tree, including sidebar, topbar, and page content.
